full_prompt_en: A square decorative illustration centers a young woman with long dark teal hair and large reflective eyes against a densely patterned floral ground. She rests her cheek on one hand, with the elbow supported below the frame, and looks upward toward the right in a quiet thoughtful pose. Her face is pale peach with softly blushed cheeks and carefully shaped rose lips. A narrow patterned band circles her hair, while a loose dark teal garment with red and turquoise circular motifs covers her shoulders. Behind her, overlapping stylized flowers, fans, leaves, and curled stems fill every inch of the background. Burnt orange, coral, ochre, muted gold, turquoise, and dark navy repeat through the ornament. Fine black contours and small stippled or textile-like marks define petals and patterned cloth. The figure's smoother face remains legible because the surrounding pattern is more finely divided and darker. Lighting is even and illustrative, with gentle gradients on skin but no realistic cast shadows. The composition has little depth in the conventional sense; layers of ornamental flat shapes create richness around a central calm silhouette. The overall impression is intimate and jewel-like, balancing a still expressive face with energetic decorative density.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰插画把一位长深青发、大眼睛的年轻女性置于密集花纹背景前。她以一只手托脸，手肘支在画框下方，安静地向右上望。面庞为浅桃色，面颊轻红，玫瑰色嘴唇描得精细。一道窄花纹带环住头发，宽松深青衣服带红与绿松石色圆纹，覆盖双肩。身后重叠的程式化花、扇形、叶和卷茎填满每处背景。焦橙、珊瑚、赭黄、低调金、绿松石和深海军蓝在装饰中重复。细黑轮廓与细点状、织物般的小痕定义花瓣与衣纹。面部更平滑，周围纹样分割更细且更暗，使人物仍易辨。光线均匀、属于插画式照明，肤色有轻渐层却无写实投影。画面缺少传统纵深；平面装饰形层叠，在宁静中央剪影周围制造丰厚感。整体亲密而宝石般明亮，静止富表情的脸与活跃装饰密度平衡。
style_prompt_en: Ornamental illustration with fine black contour, dense interlocking floral and fanlike motifs, textile stipple, and saturated jewel-tone color. Smooth pale focal planes sit against finely divided turquoise, navy, coral, ochre, and muted gold fields. Repetition creates rhythm without realistic spatial depth. Even illustrative light, careful small patterning, and a calm central silhouette give the work a tactile tapestry quality.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰插画，以细黑轮廓、密集咬合的花与扇形纹、织物点描和饱和宝石色组成。平滑浅色焦点平面对照被细分的绿松石、海军蓝、珊瑚、赭黄和低调金色场。重复带来节奏，不依靠写实空间纵深。均匀插画光、精细小纹和宁静中央剪影形成可触的织锦质感。
theme_en: A blue-haired woman before a dense floral tapestry
theme_zh: 一位蓝发女性置于密集花卉织锦前
name: Faiza Maghni
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
